digest.component_or_area: Rebar Agent structured output and usage accounting
propositions: Successful multi-attempt Agent runs must report aggregate usage (sum of all attempts) as a single row in memory, telemetry, and durable JSONL, never per-attempt or with subtraction of rejected outputs

Validation-failure exhaustion must re-raise the identical original Rebar StructuredOutputError object by walking the UnexpectedModelBehavior cause chain; repeated-truncation exhaustion must construct a fresh UnretryableOutputError when no Rebar object is present on the chain

Terminal failure diagnostics must preserve consumed requests and tokens without creating fictional usage for calls that reported none, and must store only the complete final provider response when artifact capture is enabled
Failure-matrix results, pricing calculations, and historical JSONL rows must remain byte-compatible apart from higher counters in successful retry cases
Usage and JSONL records must contain no competing request-budget fields such as candidate_requests
